# pve_container_remote_migrate (Action)

Migrate a container to a remote cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_container_remote_migrate" "example" {
  config {
    node            = "pve1"
    target_bridge   = "CHANGE_ME"
    target_endpoint = "CHANGE_ME"
    target_storage  = "CHANGE_ME"
    vmid            = 100
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_container_remote_migrate.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `target_bridge` (String) Mapping from source to target bridges. Providing only a single bridge ID maps all source bridges to that bridge. Providing the special value '1' will map each source bridge to itself.
- `target_endpoint` (String) Remote target endpoint
- `target_storage` (String) Mapping from source to target storages. Providing only a single storage ID maps all source storages to that storage. Providing the special value '1' will map each source storage to itself.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Optional

- `bwlimit` (Number) Override I/O bandwidth limit (in KiB/s). (default: migrate limit from datacenter or storage config)
- `delete` (Boolean) Delete the original CT and related data after successful migration. By default the original CT is kept on the source cluster in a stopped state. (default: 0)
- `online` (Boolean) Use online/live migration.
- `restart` (Boolean) Use restart migration
- `target_vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds for shutdown for restart migration (default: 180)
